# Grounded — Provable RAG: AI assistants that cite their sources

> A live provable-RAG demonstration by Emilio Rigales: two production-style conversational AI assistants (customer support + sales) for a fictional SaaS company called Nimbus. Hybrid retrieval — semantic embeddings + keyword ranking merged with reciprocal rank fusion — that visitors can inspect directly in a "Retrieval X-ray" view (ranked chunks with scores, no generation). Every answer is retrieved from a 36-passage knowledge base and cited; citations click through to the highlighted source. Includes an editable knowledge base, escalation with illustrative tickets, voice input, SSE streaming, fair-use rate limits, and honest "not in the knowledge base" fallbacks.

- Demo: https://nimbus-ai-demos.vercel.app/
- Retrieval X-ray: open the site → "Retrieval X-ray" tab (ranking layer alone, scores included)
- Source: https://github.com/TC26-max/Service_Agents_Demo
- Stack: static HTML/JS frontend; Vercel serverless functions (/api/chat = hybrid RAG + citation-grounded generation with SSE streaming; /api/transcribe = speech-to-text); provider-flexible OpenAI-compatible API (currently Google Gemini).
- Nimbus is fictional; all data is illustrative. The site is a portfolio demonstration, not a real product.
